points.point: Can GET /v2/comments be filtered to audience comments only (isAuthor false)?
Customer says ?isAuthor=false already tried and does nothing (still fails after trying)

verdict.reason: No candidate states whether GET /v2/comments supports an isAuthor filter; the closest entry, comment-on-posts-support, only says reading returns audience replies and your own, which is a neighboring question, and the customer also reports the parameter already failed after trying.
